sources.snippet: Open-weight AI models: the complete database Open-weight models — from DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Alibaba, Meta, Mistral, MiniMax, and OpenAI — now compete directly with proprietary flagships. This database tracks every major open source model: parameters, context windows, licenses, API pricing, benchmarks, and what it takes to run each one yourself.

sources.snippet: Efficient Architecture: The IQuest-Coder-V1-Loop variant introduces a recurrent mechanism that optimizes the trade-off between model capacity and deployment footprint. The 7B and 14B models adopt shallow architectures for faster inference speed.
